settings.q: Can you build a specific city or development?
settings.a: Yes. We model any city, district or master plan to your chosen scale - send us the area and we'll advise the best size.

settings.q: Can the model be colour-finished or lit?
settings.a: Yes - any color is possible, multicolor colour and LED lighting options are available. Tell us your preference in a commission inquiry.

settings.q: Is it suitable for repeated exhibition use?
settings.a: Yes, it is built on a sturdy base for transport and reuse across events.

settings.hero_desc: A crisp white 3D-printed energy model of a city, building, solar panels, wind turbine reproduced to scale on a clean display base. Perfect for exhibitions, sales galleries and corporate lobbies that need to show energy infrastructure of city or development at a glance.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your city, area or development, scale, and base branding
settings.s1_body: A physical city energy model communicates scale and context in a way a screen never can. We 3D-print every energy detail like solar panels, wind turbine, transmission lines, factories in a clean monochrome finish that reads beautifully under gallery lighting. Use it to present a power district, a master plan or an entire Energy Grid to investors, buyers and visitors - and we can build it for any city you choose.
settings.case_body: Esyasoft wanted to showcase their energy infrastructure to their clients in Gitex. They came to us with just 3 days of deadline. We 3d printed miniature of their energy infrastructure which helped them to showcase in their GITEX event.
settings.case_quote: Visitors gathered around it immediately. It explained our project better than any slide could.
settings.prov_p: Energy and Electricity is an important part of our daily life. Without energy, there is no progress or future development for mankind. We would have been stuck in cave without the existence of Energy. Energy is a Symbol of Progress
